_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "profiles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "goal" TEXT NOT NULL, "experience" TEXT NOT NULL, "equipment" TEXT NOT NULL, "days_per_week" INTEGER NOT NULL, "preferred_days" TEXT NOT NULL, "session_minutes" INTEGER NOT NULL, "avoid" TEXT NOT NULL, "units" TEXT NOT NULL, "onboarding_done_at" TEXT NULL, "disclaimer_accepted_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "programs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "split_type" TEXT NOT NULL, "generated_by_version" INTEGER NOT NULL, "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), "started_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "program_days" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "program_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES programs (id), "day_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "program_exercises" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "program_day_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES program_days (id), "exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "sets" INTEGER NOT NULL, "rep_min" INTEGER NOT NULL, "rep_max" INTEGER NOT NULL, "rest_seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL, "reason" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workouts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "program_day_id" TEXT NULL REFERENCES program_days (id), "day_index" INTEGER NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "started_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "finished_at" TEXT NULL, "duration_s" INTEGER NULL, "feeling" TEXT NULL, "notes" TEXT NULL, "status" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workout_exercises" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "workout_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workouts (id), "exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "sort_order" INTEGER NOT NULL, "rep_min" INTEGER NOT NULL, "rep_max" INTEGER NOT NULL, "rest_seconds" INTEGER NOT NULL, "skipped" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("skipped" IN (0, 1)), PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workout_sets" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "workout_exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workout_exercises (id), "set_index" INTEGER NOT NULL, "weight_kg" REAL NULL, "reps" INTEGER NOT NULL, "target_reps" INTEGER NOT NULL, "rpe" INTEGER NULL, "is_warmup" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("is_warmup" IN (0, 1)), "completed_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "exercise_states" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE, "current_weight_kg" REAL NULL, "current_rep_target" INTEGER NOT NULL, "stall_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_total_reps" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_decision" TEXT NULL, "last_progressed_at" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "settings" ("key" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("key"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "xp_events" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_id" TEXT NULL, "amount" INTEGER NOT NULL, "occurred_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "personal_records" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "updated_at" TEXT NOT NULL, "deleted_at" TEXT NULL, "exercise_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "value" REAL NOT NULL, "previous" REAL NOT NULL, "weight_kg" REAL NOT NULL, "reps" INTEGER NOT NULL, "workout_id" TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES workouts (id), "achieved_at" TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
